novel_features.name: Cross-portal match
novel_features.description: Tell whether a stored Immovlan listing is also on Immoweb, at what price, or is Immovlan-only.
novel_features.rationale: Joins this CLI's local store with immoweb-pp-cli's local store by address, photos and price+surface; no portal knows the other.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use it to dedupe a cross-portal sourcing run or to find Immovlan exclusives before calling an agency.

novel_features.name: PEB trap
novel_features.description: List PEB F or G properties that are currently rented: owners who can no longer re-let in Brussels since 2026.
novel_features.rationale: Needs the detail-page PEB letter and the rented flag together, which no site filter exposes.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use it when the question is which sellers are structurally motivated, not merely cheap.

novel_features.name: Bulk detail enrichment
novel_features.description: Fill missing detail fields (PEB letter, street, geo, rented, cadastral income, agency software) for many stored listings in one resumable pass.
novel_features.rationale: Search cards only carry bands and no address; the store remembers what is already known so only gaps are fetched.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Run it after find and before peb-trap, same-as or split-candidates so their inputs exist.

novel_features.name: Division candidates
novel_features.description: Houses large enough to divide, ranked by €/m² within their postcode, with land, year, PEB and rented flags.
novel_features.rationale: Immovlan has no surface filter; the ranking needs the whole stored area.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use it for a trader who divides houses into apartments; find cannot filter by surface.

novel_features.name: Re-listing detector
novel_features.description: Listings that came back under a new reference, with their true first-seen date and price at each reference.
novel_features.rationale: The site resets the Nouveau ribbon and datePosted per reference; only the local history links them.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use it to expose a fake Nouveau before negotiating on ancienneté.

novel_features.name: Agency leaderboard
novel_features.description: Which agencies list in a zone, their PEB F/G share, private-seller share and the CRM software behind each feed.
novel_features.rationale: Group-by on the local store plus the dataLayer software field captured during enrich.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use it to see which feeds are syndicated (likely also on Immoweb) versus Rossel-exclusive.

narrative.headline: Search Immovlan from the terminal with every site filter, keep a local history, and cross it with Immoweb: exclusives, re-listings, rented PEB F/G traps and division candidates.
narrative.value_prop: Reads the same server-rendered pages the immovlan.be site serves, with no login, and stores every result in SQLite. Field names mirror immoweb-pp-cli so a sourcing job can merge both portals, and same-as tells you which listings exist only on Immovlan. enrich fills the detail fields the search cards never show, and peb-trap, split-candidates and relisted answer the questions a property trader asks before calling an agency.

quickstart.comment: Confirm immovlan.be answers plain HTTP from this machine
Search Schaerbeek and Saint-Josse for bad-PEB sales; every result lands in the local store
Read one listing: PEB letter, street, surfaces, year, cadastral income, seller, datePosted
Fill detail fields for the stored listings that lack them
Rented F/G properties: owners who cannot re-let since 2026
Listings that are not on Immoweb (reads immoweb-pp-cli's store)

troubleshoots.fix: Immovlan blocks headless browsers, not plain HTTP: keep the default Chrome User-Agent (do not override --user-agent) and run from a normal network; check with immovlan-pp-cli doctor

troubleshoots.symptom: find returns fewer listings than the site shows
troubleshoots.fix: The result count is rendered client-side; raise --pages (20 per page) and watch total_matching, which is estimated from the pagination

troubleshoots.symptom: epc is a band (bad/poor) instead of a letter
troubleshoots.fix: Cards carry the band only when the watermark is missing; run immovlan-pp-cli enrich --missing epc to read the letter from the detail page
Install immoweb-pp-cli and run a find or pull there first, or point --immoweb-db at its SQLite file
Use the reference from the listing URL (vbe…, rbu…, rbw…) or paste the full URL; withdrawn listings return 404

narrative.when_to_use: Reach for this CLI when a task needs Belgian listings from Immovlan: searching a commune with price, bedroom and PEB filters, reading a listing's full details, tracking what is new or cheaper, or crossing Immovlan with Immoweb for a property trader's sourcing. It is the second portal next to immoweb-pp-cli in the brussels-peb-hunter job.
anti_triggers: Do not use it to contact sellers or agencies, place bids, or fill site forms (Turnstile-protected).
Do not use it for Immoweb, Zimmo or Biddit data; use immoweb-pp-cli or the Biddit feed in the sourcing job.
Do not use it for sold prices or market medians; Immovlan shows asking prices only.

recipes.explanation: First run is a baseline; later runs report new, price-changed and gone listings since the previous run.
